kyoto_shozankaku_matsuyama_isetan.gf_detail: Ask: Tabelog says allergy information is available; yuba and soy milk are naturally wheat-free, but yuba tempura, fu and ponzu are on the courses (2026 reviews).
kyoto_shozankaku_matsuyama_isetan.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dashi throughout; sashimi, fish, shrimp and conger eel in the courses (2026 reviews).
kyoto_shozankaku_matsuyama_isetan.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 11:00–22:00 (last order 21:15); closed on JR Kyoto Isetan's closing days. Reservations taken (private rooms by phone); seating about 2 hours. No service charge — Tabelog, Japanese original 「無」. 42 seats; private rooms for 8 and for 10–20; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; English menu with photos; allergy information available; children welcome with a kids' menu. Cards (Visa, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay); no e-money or QR. On the 11th floor of JR Kyoto Isetan, with views of Kyoto Tower and the mountains (2026 reviews).
kyoto_shozankaku_matsuyama_isetan.notes: [Yuba kaiseki · Kyoto Station Isetan 11F, warm yuba in a tub] The station branch of a Kyoto yuba-cuisine house: warm, freshly made yuba scooped from a wooden tub with ponzu, yuba sashimi and tempura, and seasonal courses, with a view toward Kyoto Tower — convenient before a train. Diners in 2026 praise the yuba; some found the service stiff or harried (September and October 2026) and one found the seasoning salty (October 2026). No service charge.

roles: Not named in a source; branch of the yuba-cuisine house 松山閣 松山, whose main restaurant is elsewhere in Kyoto (Gurunavi)
chef_bio.background: Reviewers in 2026 describe a calm restaurant on the department-store restaurant floor with views of the mountains and Kyoto Tower, kimono-clad servers, rice crackers and hot water on arrival, and yuba that a September 2026 diner was told is made at a shop near Kinkaku-ji.
chef_bio.specialty: Homemade yuba in a wooden tub (yuba-oke).

anecdotes.text: September 2026: "the service felt a bit disorganized, possibly due to being busy. The staff could have been a bit more friendly."
October 2026: "I found the saltiness to be quite pronounced, despite the presentation" — and the "matsutake rice" turned out to be mushroom rice.
October 2026: "the signature homemade yuba bucket was exquisite; I almost drank all the soy milk without realizing it."
October 2026: "the service from the most experienced-looking woman in a kimono was a bit intimidating."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 京料理・本家生ゆば料理 松山閣 松山 JR京都伊勢丹店、日本料理・豆腐料理、下京区烏丸通塩小路下る東塩小路町901 ジェイアール京都伊勢丹 11F、JR京都駅から徒歩1分、毎日 11:00〜22:00 (L.O. 21:15)、休みはJR京都伊勢丹に準じる、予約可 (個室は電話で)、利用は2時間ほど、原文でサービス料「無」、42席、個室 (8名、10〜20名)、禁煙、車椅子可、英語と写真のメニュー、アレルギー表示あり、子供可・子供メニュー、カード可、電子マネー・QR不可。口コミ (2026年8〜10月、英語): 自家製の湯葉桶をポン酢で、豆乳、湯葉刺し、湯葉の天ぷら、豆腐の味噌田楽、季節の京弁当4,070円 (湯葉桶付き、きのこご飯はおかわり可、湯葉バウムクーヘン)、「Miyabi」コース5,500円、「Sakae」の会席 (松茸の土瓶蒸し、鰆の幽庵焼き、蓮根饅頭)、京都タワーや山の眺め、湯葉は金閣寺の近くの店で作るとの説明、サービスが慌ただしいという声、塩気が強いという声、年長の着物の女性の接客が怖かったという声。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu with photos; allergy information available.

existence.note: Tabelog listing with reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_miki_keiran_nishiki.gf_detail: Ask: the dashimaki dashi is kombu with urume, soda-katsuo and mackerel flakes (official site), but soy seasoning is not stated; the sandwiches, buns and cream puffs are wheat.
kyoto_miki_keiran_nishiki.vegan_detail: Not vegan: egg dishes in a fish dashi (official site).
kyoto_miki_keiran_nishiki.hours_raw: Official site and Tabelog: 9:00–17:00 daily; closed only at New Year. Take-away counter with a small standing eat-in space and a bin; staff will cut a dashimaki for eating on the spot (2024–2025 reviews). No reservations. Tabelog lists no cards, e-money or QR, but a March 2026 diner paid with PayPay. Popular items (pudding) sell out; a sold-out dashimaki can be made fresh if you wait (October 2025).
kyoto_miki_keiran_nishiki.notes: [Dashimaki · Nishiki Market, since 1928] A Nishiki Market egg shop since 1928 where craftsmen hand-roll dashi-heavy dashimaki in custom copper pans: buy a small roll to eat at the stand, a green-onion or eel roll, or the dashimaki sandwich and pudding. One diner expected it hot and got it cold (September 2026). Open daily 9:00–17:00.

roles: Not named in a source; Miki Keiran Co., Ltd. (official site)
chef_bio.background: Founded in Showa 3 (1928), with its main shop near the middle of Nishiki Market (official site). The dashi uses Nishiki well water and Rishiri kombu simmered slowly, with urume, soda-katsuo and mackerel flakes; every roll is still hand-cooked, rolled front to back in the "Kyo-maki" style over high heat in long, heavy copper pans made to order by Aritsugu, a craftsman working three pans at once (official site). Counters at Takashimaya Kyoto and JR Kyoto Isetan, and a bakery of egg breads and sweets, mikikeirando (official site).
chef_bio.philosophy: From its site: "創業以来、伝承の技法で変わらぬ味を守っています" (since its founding, keeping the same taste with handed-down techniques).

anecdotes.text: January 2024: in a Nishiki now full of bar-like eateries, "the traditional ambiance still remains at a place called Miki Keiran."
May 2024: "If you want to eat it now, I'll cut the dashimaki for you," said the staff — "They even gave me three chopsticks."
September 2026: "I expected it to be freshly made, but it was cold, which was a bit disappointing."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 昭和三年創業のだし巻玉子専門店、錦市場のほぼ真ん中に本店、錦の井戸水と利尻昆布、うるめ節・宗田鰹・さば節の出汁、職人が一本ずつ手焼き、有次の特注の銅の玉子焼鍋、手前から奥へ巻く「京巻き」、三本の鍋を同時に使う、だし巻 (小690円・中1,050円・大1,700円・特上1,950円)、九条ねぎ巻1,190円、かやく巻1,600円、う巻2,800円、ふくさ焼580円、錦本店は9:00〜17:00で年始以外無休、高島屋京都店とJR京都伊勢丹店、パンと菓子の三木鶏卵堂 (mikikeirando)。食べログ: 三木鶏卵、日本料理・パン、中京区錦小路通富小路西入東魚屋町182、予約不可、持ち帰り、カード・電子マネー・QR不可。口コミ (2024年1月〜2026年9月、英語): だし巻、九条ねぎ巻、う巻、だし巻サンド、黄身あんぱん、クリームパン、シュークリーム、瓶のプリン、店の前で立って食べられる、PayPayで払えたという声、冷めていたという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Take-away counter in Nishiki Market; small standing space.

existence.note: Official site lists the Nishiki main shop; Tabelog reviews through September 2026.

kyoto_koka_ryuho_rihga.gf_detail: Ask. Cantonese courses of dim sum, sauces with soy and bean paste, fried rice and noodles; staff help tailor orders (2023–2025 reviews).
kyoto_koka_ryuho_rihga.vegan_detail: Not vegan: shark-fin soup, seafood, beef and chicken courses (2023–2025 reviews).
kyoto_koka_ryuho_rihga.hours_raw: Daily 11:30–15:30 (last order 14:30) and 17:00–21:30 (last order 20:00); irregular closing days, see the hotel website (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). A 10% service charge (Tabelog original サービス料10%). 78 seats with private rooms for 4 to over 30 (room fee); stroller-friendly (Tabelog; December 2023). À la carte in small or medium plates (December 2023). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). B1F of RIHGA Royal Hotel Kyoto; hotel parking free for 3 hours with a ¥4,000 spend from 1 April 2026; 7 min walk west of Kyoto Station (Tabelog).
kyoto_koka_ryuho_rihga.notes: [Cantonese · RIHGA Royal Hotel Kyoto B1F] The hotel's calm Cantonese room near Kyoto Station: lunch courses of appetisers, shark-fin soup, dim sum, XO-steamed sea bream and seafood fried rice, à la carte in small portions, and private rooms often used for family gatherings and memorials. Attentive service; one 2024 dinner guest found it merely average. Plus 10% service. Open daily.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: the Chinese restaurant of RIHGA Royal Hotel Kyoto, with dim sum and private rooms; registered as an official listing by the operator. An October 2025 reviewer recalls the building was once the Kyoto Grand Hotel.

anecdotes.text: For the hotel's 55th-anniversary lunch in December 2024, staff set the table to match what the guest had mentioned when booking.
After a memorial service in November 2025, a family gathered in a private room here around the late uncle's portrait.
An October 2023 diner could not find any shark fin in the shark-fin soup, but still found it very good.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 中華料理・飲茶、下京区東堀川通り塩小路下ル松明町1 リーガロイヤルホテル京都 B1F、JR京都駅から西へ徒歩約7分、毎日 11:30〜15:30 (L.O.14:30)・17:00〜21:30 (L.O.20:00)、不定休、予約可、サービス料10%、78席、個室 (4名〜30名以上、別料金)、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、2026年4月1日から4,000円以上の利用でホテルの駐車場3時間無料。口コミ (2023年4月〜2025年11月、英語): 広東料理、「Kofuku」ランチ (前菜、ふかひれスープ、点心、XO 醤の鯛の蒸し物、牛肉の甜麺醤炒めとクレープ、海鮮のあんかけチャーハン、デザート)、カジュアルランチ (帆立の蒸し物、朝天唐辛子の鶏)、海老チリ2種、蟹入りのふかひれスープ、小皿と中皿のアラカルト、ベビーカーで個室へ、ホテル55周年のランチ、法事のあとの会食、平凡との声 (2024年8月)、昔の京都グランドホテル。

cultural_comfort.note: Hotel restaurant; 10% service; private rooms; cards, IC and QR.

existence.note: Official Tabelog listing; latest review November 2025.

kyoto_cantina_rossi_demachi.gf_detail: Not GF: handmade fresh pasta is the heart of every course, with crostini, cutlets and tiramisu (2021–2026 reviews).
kyoto_cantina_rossi_demachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: cream and Gorgonzola pastas, nduja, lamb and beef cutlets, cheese and ham (2021–2026 reviews).
kyoto_cantina_rossi_demachi.hours_raw: Tuesday, Thursday and Saturday 12:00–14:30 and 18:00–21:30; Monday, Wednesday and Friday 18:00–21:30; closed Sunday; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations accepted and advised — about three groups fit at once (Tabelog; February 2024, August 2026). No e-money or QR (Tabelog). 10 seats; non-smoking (Tabelog). An iron sculpture marks the door, down a narrow residential lane; 7 min walk from Demachiyanagi Stn (Tabelog; February 2024).
kyoto_cantina_rossi_demachi.notes: [Italian · Demachiyanagi back lane, couple-run] A ten-seat Italian tucked in a residential lane behind an iron sculpture, run by a friendly couple: handmade pastas such as Gorgonzola cream or Amatriciana, crostini, lamb or beef cutlet, tiramisu and Italian wine, at prices reviewers call remarkable — lunch from ¥2,670, a dinner omakase near ¥4,800. Pastas can be split to share. Book; closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: an Italian restaurant near Demachiyanagi with a website at cantinarossi.com. Reviewers describe a couple running the ground floor of a house in a residential area (June 2024; April 2025), and say it was listed as a Michelin Bib Gourmand in 2021 and 2022 (September 2021; March 2022).

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 pair, waiting outside before noon, were waved in three minutes early with a "Please come in".
A September 2021 diner who mentioned a birthday found a surprise on the plate.
A January 2026 couple, the only guests that evening, had the pasta served divided onto two plates.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: イタリアン、左京区吉田泉殿町57-1、京阪出町柳駅から徒歩7分、火・木・土 12:00〜14:30・18:00〜21:30、月・水・金 18:00〜21:30、日曜定休、予約可、電子マネー・QR 不可、10席、禁煙。口コミ (2021年9月〜2026年8月、英語): 住宅街の路地、鉄のオブジェ、家の1階、夫婦で営む、3組ほどで満席、ランチ PRANZO 2,670円から (クロスティーニ3種、5〜6種から選ぶパスタ、ドリンク)、野菜の前菜の盛り合わせ1,300円、生パスタ (ゴルゴンゾーラのクリーム、アマトリチャーナ、ンドゥイヤのトマトクリーム、きのことレモンのタリアテッレ、茄子とトマト)、取り分けて半量ずつ、夜のおまかせ4,800円台 (パン、前菜、パスタ2種、羊や牛のカツレツ、デザート、ドリンク)、ティラミス、イタリアワイン、ミシュランのビブグルマン (2021年・2022年) との声、誕生日のサプライズ。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead (10 seats); pasta can be split to share; no e-money or QR.

kyoto_kyo_yoshoku_matsumoto.gf_detail: Not GF: demi-glace hamburg, omurice with hayashi or demi-glace, tonkatsu and beef cutlet (2026 reviews).
kyoto_kyo_yoshoku_matsumoto.vegan_detail: Not vegan: hamburg, ginger pork, steak, cutlets and pork miso soup (2026 reviews).
kyoto_kyo_yoshoku_matsumoto.hours_raw: Tuesday–Sunday 11:30–15:00 (last entry 14:15) and 18:00–22:00 (last entry 21:00); closed Monday (open on holiday Mondays, closed the next Tuesday) plus further posted days — in November 2026 the 2nd, 9th, 10th, 16th, 24th and 30th (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; tatami seats by phone request; change times by phone (Tabelog). At dinner, a ¥500 charge if you do not order food (Tabelog original ディナー時間帯は食事をされない場合はチャージ料￥５００). 37 seats: 9 at the counter and 28 at tables incl. 8 on tatami; private room (Tabelog). Cards; PayPay per a July 2026 review (Tabelog; July 2026). A machiya with a Jizo shrine; 8 min walk from Karasuma or Shijo stations (Tabelog).
kyoto_kyo_yoshoku_matsumoto.notes: [Yoshoku · machiya west of Shijo Karasuma, Kyoto vegetables] A calm machiya with a Jizo shrine serving yoshoku built around Kyoto produce: demi-glace or tomato hamburg, caper-sauced ginger pork, beef cutlet and a soufflé omurice, each with a heap of grilled vegetables and pork miso soup. Some find the flavours unusual — one guest tasted liver in the hamburg. Book; closed Monday and posted days.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a machiya-style yoshoku restaurant with a Jizo shrine, using Kyoto vegetables and meats; registered as an official listing by the shop, which offers message plates with dessert by phone request. Reviewers in 2026 describe a popular, calm restaurant with reservations streaming in at opening (October 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: Kyoto vegetables and meats in yoshoku (October 2026 review).

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 diner found pink peppercorns piled on the salad and a hamburg tasting strongly of liver, almost like pâté.
An October 2026 mother and daughter, put off the hamburg by reviews mentioning liver, chose the demi-glace omurice and loved it.
A fourth-visit regular in August 2026 always orders the adult hamburg with tomato sauce.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 洋食・ビストロ・ステーキ、中京区不動町171-4、阪急烏丸駅・地下鉄四条駅から徒歩8分、火〜日 11:30〜15:00 (最終入店14:15)・18:00〜22:00 (最終入店21:00)、月曜定休 (祝日は営業し翌火曜休み)、ほかの休み (11月: 2・9・10・16・24・30日)、予約可 (座敷は電話で、時間変更は電話で)、ディナー時間帯は食事をされない場合はチャージ料500円、37席 (カウンター9、テーブル28、うち座敷8)、個室、カード可、メッセージプレートはデザート注文時に電話で、お地蔵さんのある町家風の洋食店。口コミ (2026年6月〜10月、英語): 京野菜と京都の肉、焼き野菜たっぷり、豚汁、トマトソースのハンバーグ、デミグラスのハンバーグ (レバーの味がするとの声)、ケッパーのソースの生姜焼き、牛カツ、とんかつ、ステーキ、スフレのオムライス (デミグラス、ハヤシ)、京野菜のサラダと前菜2種のコース、帰りに漬物を買える、PayPay 可 (2026年7月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; phone for tatami or time changes; ¥500 charge at dinner without food; cards.

existence.note: Official Tabelog listing; reviews through October 2026.

kyoto_beer_restaurant_munchen.gf_detail: Not GF: kara-age, tonkatsu with demi-glace, fries, tacos and beer (2026 reviews).
kyoto_beer_restaurant_munchen.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fried chicken, pork cutlet, sausages, roast beef and smoked salmon (2026 reviews).
kyoto_beer_restaurant_munchen.hours_raw: Daily 11:30–23:00 (last order 22:00), open straight through (Tabelog; August 2026). Reservations accepted; banquet courses for 4 or more by the day before; call for 11 or more (Tabelog). 289 seats: 1F with 66 in the Ohenback area and 23 standing, 2F with 200; private rooms; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; karaoke and projector (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR incl. Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). In the first lane east off Kawaramachi north of Shijo; 3 min walk from Kyoto-Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_beer_restaurant_munchen.notes: [Beer hall · Shijo Kawaramachi lane, open all day] A big, old-school beer restaurant just off Kawaramachi, open from 11:30 straight to 23:00: brewery-fresh draught in sizes up to a litre, Hoegaarden on tap, a famous crisp kara-age of chicken breast, demi-glace tonkatsu sets at lunch and a ¥1,250 beer-and-two-plates afternoon set. Families at lunch, parties at night. Open daily.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a beer hall serving nostalgic yoshoku with freshly brewed beer delivered from the brewery; registered as an official listing by the operator. Our crawls also list ビヤレストラン ハウスミュンヘン at the same address.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 regular on a sixth visit had the tonkatsu set — "It's a shame I can't drink beer, though," noted on an earlier visit in May.
An October 2026 group booked at 17:00 the day before and stayed four hours over a one-litre mug.
An October 2026 wedding party found it one of the few places open for drinks at 14:30 on a Sunday.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ビアホール・洋食・唐揚げ、中京区河原町通四条上ル一筋目東入ル、阪急河原町駅から徒歩3分、京阪祇園四条駅から徒歩5分、毎日 11:30〜23:00 (L.O.22:00)、予約可 (宴会コースは4名以上・前日まで、11名以上は電話で)、289席 (1階 66席と立ち飲み23、2階200席)、個室、禁煙、車椅子可、カラオケ、プロジェクター、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、醸造所直送の生ビールと懐かしい洋食。口コミ (2026年5月〜10月、英語): ビールのサイズが豊富 (1L のジョッキも)、ヒューガルデンの生、ピッチャー、黒とハーフ&ハーフ、名物の胸肉の唐揚げ、とんかつ定食1,250円 (デミグラス)、プレーンオムレツの定食1,050円、「quick drink」のセット1,250円 (ビールと2品)、ソーセージの盛り合わせ、フライドポテト、ポップコーン、飲み放題の宴会コース、昼から夜まで通し営業、家族連れも。

cultural_comfort.note: Big hall, easy to walk in; banquet courses by the day before; cards, IC and QR.

existence.note: Official Tabelog listing; reviews through October 2026.

kyoto_fromagerie_harmonie.gf_detail: Ask. Cheesecakes; crusts are not described (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_fromagerie_harmonie.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a cheese shop and cheesecake café (Tabelog).
kyoto_fromagerie_harmonie.hours_raw: Sat–Mon 11:00–17:30 (last order 17:00); Tue, Wed and Fri 11:00–16:30 (last order 16:00); closed Thursday (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 8 counter seats in a small basement room, often full; take-away cheesecakes and cheeses (Tabelog; 2025 reviews). Non-smoking. In the basement of a narrow building on Nijo-dori in Okazaki, near Miyako Messe and Heian Shrine; 7 min from Higashiyama Stn (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_fromagerie_harmonie.notes: [Cheese shop & cheesecake · Okazaki] A tiny basement cheese shop off Nijo-dori with eight counter seats: six rich cheesecakes — try the Gorgonzola or ricotta — with Ronnefeldt tea for ¥1,100, and cheeses to take away. Handy after the museums. Closed Thursday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviewers: one of the few cheese specialists in Kyoto, with a cheesecake counter in the basement.

anecdotes.text: A September 2025 visitor was told a ricotta cheesecake and cream orange tea "work well together" — and found the pairing worked.
Finding the eight seats full in September 2025, a visitor was about to leave when someone vacated a seat.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): FROMAGERIE Harmonie (フロマージェリー アルモニー)、カフェ・ケーキ、左京区岡崎成勝寺町1-8 B1F、東山駅から443m、土〜月 11:00〜17:30 (L.O. 17:00)、火水金 11:00〜16:30 (L.O. 16:00)、木曜休み、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、8席、禁煙。口コミ (2024年8月〜2026年6月、英語): 京都でも数少ないチーズ専門店、地下の小さなカウンター、チーズケーキ6種 (リコッタ、マスカルポーネ、甘さ半分のゴルゴンゾーラ、生キャラメルとゴーダ650円)、ケーキセット1,100円、ロンネフェルトの紅茶490円、持ち帰りのチーズ、満席になることも。

cultural_comfort.note: Small counter; staff suggest tea pairings.

existence.note: Tabelog listing kept by the shop; reviews dated through June 2026.

kyoto_imaya_coffee.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: breakfast is toast or a hot sandwich (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_imaya_coffee.vegan_detail: Not vegan: breakfast with egg, chicken, cheese and yogurt; milk coffees (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_imaya_coffee.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 6:00–13:00 and 16:00–20:00; Sat–Sun 6:00–13:00; hours may change (Tabelog). Bookings taken (Tabelog). Cards and PayPay (Tabelog). 15 seats with counter and sofas; non-smoking (Tabelog). Some staff speak English (November 2025 review). The café of the IMAYA guesthouse, in a renovated machiya near Okine Shrine; 5 min from Karasuma Oike Stn, near Nijojo-mae (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_imaya_coffee.notes: [Neapolitan café · near Oike] A bright machiya café attached to a guesthouse, open from 6:00: a creamy cappuccino reviewers call the best ever, a hot-sandwich breakfast (about ¥1,000), fresh orange juice and Neapolitan craft beer. Popular with Italian and other foreign visitors; English spoken.

roles: Owner (unnamed), who also runs a guesthouse
chef_bio.background: A June 2026 reviewer says the owner, passionate about coffee, also runs a guesthouse; an August 2026 regular of four years says the café was featured in the southern Italian paper Il Mattino and on Italian media, and draws ever more Italian visitors.

anecdotes.text: A couple who loved this coffee in Naples came in July 2026 on a friend's tip and found the room full of the city's atmosphere.
A September 2026 guest who dislikes soft-boiled eggs had the egg cooked through on request.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: IMAYA Kyoto &COFFEE (イマヤ ホステルキョウトプラスコーヒー)、カフェ、中京区釜座通御池上ル下松屋町726-4、烏丸御池駅から357m、月〜金 6:00〜13:00・16:00〜20:00、土日 6:00〜13:00、予約可、カード・PayPay 可、15席、禁煙。口コミ (2025年11月〜2026年9月、英語): ナポリ風のカフェ、カプチーノ620円 (Passalacqua のカップ)、朝食セット (鶏とチーズのホットサンドと半熟卵1,040円)、Zummo の生オレンジジュース、イタリアのクラフトビール、ゲストハウスも営む店主、Il Mattino に掲載、外国人客やイタリア人客が多い、英語を話すスタッフ。

cultural_comfort.note: Some English-speaking staff (November 2025 review); many international guests.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through September 2026.

kyoto_all_day_dining_rajou.gf_detail: Ask. A buffet of Japanese, Western and Chinese dishes, grilled meats and desserts; dish labelling not described (2026 reviews).
kyoto_all_day_dining_rajou.vegan_detail: Ask. Salads and vegetables among many meat, fish and dairy dishes (2026 reviews).
kyoto_all_day_dining_rajou.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–15:00 daily; dinner 17:30–21:30 on weekdays, 17:30–21:00 at weekends and holidays (Tabelog); a breakfast buffet also runs (September 2026 review). Bookings taken; 100% cancellation charge from two days before (Tabelog). Service charge: 15% — Tabelog's Japanese original says 「サービス料15%※2025年4月1日のご利用よりサービス料をご利用額（税抜）の15%に改定させていただきます。」. Cards, IC cards and QR (Tabelog). 90 seats under a six-storey atrium; non-smoking; parking 50 cars, ¥800 per 30 min with restaurant benefits (Tabelog). 2F of the Kyoto Century Hotel, 2 min east of Kyoto Station's central gate (Tabelog).
kyoto_all_day_dining_rajou.notes: [Hotel buffet · Kyoto Century Hotel by Kyoto Station] The hotel's bright atrium restaurant, two minutes from the station: a theatre-style buffet whose live kitchen rotates wagyu roast beef and other meats every half hour, plus breakfast and seasonal sweets buffets. Dinner about ¥6,000–9,000 before the 15% service charge.

roles: Restaurant of the Kyoto Century Hotel (no person named)
chef_bio.background: Opened 11 August 2012 (Tabelog), in the Kyoto Century Hotel of Keihan Hotels & Resorts (official site). A long-time regular notes a significant renovation in 2026 (September 2026 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Theatre-style buffet with live meat kitchen.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 guest found the buffet tasty but narrow for a hotel, with meats ordered and grilled in turns so one could not eat much, and the value not great.
A September 2026 lunch guest found the all-you-can-drink service a little slow.
Before an October 2026 Shinkansen, a visitor enjoyed the weekday lunch with well-spaced tables.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): オールデイダイニング ラジョウ、レストラン・カフェ・洋食、下京区東塩小路町680 京都センチュリーホテル 2F、JR京都駅中央口から東へ徒歩2分、平日 11:30〜15:00・17:30〜21:30、土日祝 11:30〜15:00・17:30〜21:00、2日前から当日のキャンセルは100%、サービス料15% (2025年4月1日から税抜額の15%に改定)、90席、禁煙、駐車場50台、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、2012年8月11日オープン、6層吹き抜け、ライブキッチン「THE THEATER BUFFET」。公式サイト: 京阪ホテルズ&リゾーツの京都センチュリーホテル。口コミ (2026年7〜11月、英語): ミートシアター (9種の肉料理を30分ごとに3種ずつ)、和牛ローストビーフ、和牛の幽庵焼き、ミートパイ、和洋中、カレー、デザート、モンブラン、昼の飲み放題、朝食ブッフェ (オムレツ、京漬物、豆腐、日本酒)、HELLO KITTY のスイーツブッフェ7,200〜8,500円、品数が少なくコスパが良くないという声。

existence.note: Tabelog listing kept by the hotel; reviews dated through November 2026.

kyoto_blend_kyoto.gf_detail: Ask. A coffee stand; no food or gluten information is published (Tabelog; reviews).
kyoto_blend_kyoto.vegan_detail: Ask. Black coffee is plant-based; ask about milk drinks (reviews).
kyoto_blend_kyoto.hours_raw: Monday, Tuesday, Thursday and Friday 12:00–17:00; Saturday, Sunday and holidays 9:00–17:00; closed Wednesday (Tabelog). No service charge listed (Tabelog). 2 seats — mostly a stand; non-smoking; cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). On Takeyamachi-dori east of Fuyacho, on the way to the Imperial Palace grounds, 578 m from Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog; October 2025).
kyoto_blend_kyoto.notes: [Coffee · Takeyamachi, blend your own cup] A tiny, stylish specialty-coffee stand on the way to the Imperial Palace grounds, run by a barista from Tokyo's GLITCH COFFEE & ROASTERS. Sniff your way through jars of light-roast beans labelled a to i, choose two, and the barista blends and brews your cup — about ¥1,200 a cup. Just two seats, so plan to stroll with it. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Per an April 2026 review: the owner trained at the renowned GLITCH COFFEE & ROASTERS in Tokyo before opening this shop in Kyoto. Reviewers describe a wide choice of light-roast beans from which guests pick two for a custom blend.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 visitor chose beans by smelling jars labelled a through i.
A November 2025 regular rates it a top pick in Kyoto for light-roast specialty coffee.
A March 2026 visitor found it busy and tried a cinnamon-flavoured coffee.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: blend kyoto (ブレンド キョウト)、コーヒースタンド、中京区竹屋町通麸屋町東入笹屋町447、丸太町駅から578m、月火木金12:00〜17:00、土日祝9:00〜17:00、水曜定休、2席、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR 可。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): 浅煎りのスペシャルティコーヒー、豆の香りを嗅いで a〜i から2種を選んでブレンド、ブレンドコーヒー1,210円 (2025年5月)、シナモンのコーヒー、東京の GLITCH COFFEE & ROASTERS で修業した店主、値段は高め。

cultural_comfort.note: Point at the bean jars; two seats only.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through July 2026.

kyoto_beer_lab.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a brewpub of malt beers, with fried snacks (2026 reviews).
kyoto_beer_lab.vegan_detail: Ask. Snacks such as edamame and fries alongside kara-age and salmon jerky; nothing vegan is marked (2026 reviews).
kyoto_beer_lab.hours_raw: 13:00–23:00 daily; hours may change (Tabelog). Order and pay at the counter after taking a seat (June 2026). No service charge listed (Tabelog). 15 seats; non-smoking; JCB, AMEX, Diners, transit IC and QR (Tabelog). Beside the Takase River, 245 m from Shichijo Stn (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Opened 30 March 2018; first batch and grand opening 27 April 2018 (Tabelog).
kyoto_beer_lab.notes: [Craft beer · Shichijo, a brewpub by the Takase River] A small brewery-bar beside the Takase River near Shichijo, pouring its own beers — from a Yakima Valley IPA to Kyoto-tea brews like hōjicha stout and kabusecha white ale — by the half (about ¥700–800) or pint (about ¥1,100–1,200). Order at the counter, sit by the water, add kara-age or fried cheese. Open daily 13:00–23:00.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: opened 30 March 2018, with its first batch and grand opening on 27 April 2018. Reviewers describe a brewpub by the Takase River with a long rotating list of house beers, including Kyoto green-tea styles.
chef_bio.specialty: House beers including hōjicha stout and kabusecha white ale.

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 visitor arrived on the anniversary and found about eight special beers on tap.
A March 2026 guest came straight from the sauna at Ume-yu nearby.
A May 2026 regular on a tenth visit dropped in just before 22:00 on a Friday.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 京都ビアラボ、ビアバー・カフェ・バル、下京区十禅師町201-3、七条駅から245m、13:00〜23:00、無休、15席、禁煙、カード (JCB・AMEX・Diners)・交通系IC・QR 可、2018年3月30日オープン、2018年4月27日に初仕込み・グランドオープン。口コミ (2026年、英語): 高瀬川沿いのブルーパブ、ハーフと US パイント、ヤキマバレーIPA 1,200円、ほうじ茶スタウト1,200円、かぶせ茶ホワイトエール700円 (ハーフ)、マカダミアブラウンエール、サワー800円 (ハーフ)、すだちミントセルツァー500円、自家製唐揚げ850円、枝豆450円、黒胡椒のフライドチーズ600円、席についてからカウンターで注文と会計、海外からの客。

cultural_comfort.note: Order and pay at the counter; many overseas visitors.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_sogen_cafe.gf_detail: Ask. Curries with rice, carrot cake, parfaits and pudding; no gluten information is published (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_sogen_cafe.vegan_detail: Ask. Chicken and pork curries and dairy sweets; nothing vegan is marked (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_sogen_cafe.hours_raw: Monday–Friday 11:00–17:00 (last order 16:30); closed Saturday, Sunday and holidays (official site; Tabelog). Online reservations taken (March 2026). No service charge listed (Tabelog). 20 seats: 8 at the counter, 12 at tables; non-smoking; no pets; cards and PayPay (Tabelog). On Shirakawa-dori in Kitashirakawa, across from Kyoto University of the Arts, 657 m from Chayama Stn (Tabelog; 2025 reviews). Opened 1 August 2005 (Tabelog); run by the Kyoto antiques and design business SOWGEN, whose Shijo café has merged into this one (official site).
kyoto_sogen_cafe.notes: [Café · Kitashirakawa, curry and parfaits among old furniture] A leafy, quietly stylish café run by the antiques shop SOWGEN, opposite Kyoto University of the Arts on Shirakawa-dori. Lunch is a gentle, vegetable-rich curry — the combination plate is about ¥1,200 — and the sweets are worth the trip: carrot cake, pudding à la mode (¥990) and small parfaits. Weekdays only; online bookings taken.

roles: Run by SOWGEN (antiques, plants and design); staff not named
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: SOWGEN deals in antiques, brocante, plants and interior design; そうげんカフェ is its Kitashirakawa café, which absorbed the café of its Shijo shop. Tabelog gives the opening as 1 August 2005; a June 2025 reviewer calls it a local staple of more than 15 years.
chef_bio.specialty: Combination curry; pudding à la mode.

anecdotes.text: A November 2025 guest who arrived just after last order was still welcomed in.
A December 2025 diner had long missed it because it opens only on weekdays, and named it a favourite café of the year.
A June 2025 visitor came after being turned away from a nearby ramen shop and stayed for the curry.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (sowgen.com): SOWGEN、古道具・古家具・植物・デザイン、北白川店 そうげんカフェ (月〜金11:00〜17:00、L.O. 16:30、土日祝休み、左京区北白川上終町10-2)、四条店のカフェは北白川そうげんカフェへ統合、北白川 sowgen brocante は2026年3月で閉店。食べログ: カフェ・ケーキ・洋食、茶山・京都芸術大学駅から657m、20席 (カウンター8、テーブル12)、禁煙、ペット不可、カード・PayPay 可、2005年8月1日オープン。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 京都芸術大学の向かい、2種のカレー1,200円ほど、バターチキンカレー、ポークキーマ、キャロットケーキ、季節のプリンアラモード990円、チョコとベリーのパフェ890円、ネット予約可。

existence.note: Official site (2026 notice) and Tabelog listing; reviews dated through April 2026.

kyoto_sumizo_yakiniku.gf_detail: Ask. Wagyu yakiniku with sweet-savoury marinades and tare; no gluten information is published (reviews).
kyoto_sumizo_yakiniku.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a wagyu yakiniku house (reviews).
kyoto_sumizo_yakiniku.hours_raw: 17:30–22:00, Monday, Friday, Saturday and Sunday; closed Tuesday–Thursday; hours may change (Tabelog). Bookings recommended. JCB, AMEX and Diners; no e-money (Tabelog). No service charge listed (Tabelog). In a residential street off Aburanokoji north of Nakadachiuri, easy to miss; about 13 min from Imadegawa Stn (742 m) and near Hotel Brighton Kyoto (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_sumizo_yakiniku.notes: [Yakiniku · Nishijin-south, a neighbourhood wagyu house] A well-loved yakiniku shop tucked in a residential street west of the Imperial Palace, where the friendly owner talks you through the cuts. Try the thick-cut harami and marinated horumon, wagyu tongue, and ask about the off-menu chateaubriand; a chirimen rice bowl rounds things off. Most spend ¥6,000–10,000. Open only Monday and Friday to Sunday evenings.

chef_bio.background: Per 2024–2026 reviews: a long-regarded yakiniku restaurant in the Imadegawa area known for fresh Kuroge wagyu, a generous owner full of grilling tips, and an off-menu chateaubriand.

anecdotes.text: A February 2025 diner who arrived around 20:00 found it quiet and got plenty of tips from the generous owner.
A November 2025 guest rated the cubed fillet steak in the Kuroge wagyu platter beyond expectations.
An August 2026 visitor staying at a nearby hotel struggled to find the hidden entrance.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 炭蔵、焼肉、上京区油小路通中立売上る油橋詰町94-1、今出川駅から742m、月金土日17:30〜22:00、火水木定休、カード (JCB・AMEX・Diners) 可、電子マネー不可。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): 今出川エリアの名店、住宅街でわかりにくい、店主おすすめの厚切りハラミと甘辛いたれのホルモン、和牛タン、カルビ、黒毛和牛の盛り合わせとヒレのサイコロステーキ、メニューにないシャトーブリアン、ちりめん丼、2杯飲んで5,500円ほど (2024年12月)、ブライトンホテルの近く。

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through August 2026.

kyoto_yuba_kameya_honke.gf_detail: Ask. Yuba and tofu kaiseki served with soy sauce, nama-fu (wheat gluten), shojin tempura and yuba-and-shrimp spring rolls; no gluten information (official menu; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_yuba_kameya_honke.vegan_detail: Some vegan options: the shojin kaiseki “Rokujo” (¥5,000 plus tax) is made without fish, shrimp, crab, meat, shellfish, egg, dairy, green onion, garlic, nira, rakkyo, onion or fish dashi, per the official menu. The yuba kaiseki courses include yuba-and-shrimp spring rolls. Book the Rokujo course ahead.
kyoto_yuba_kameya_honke.hours_raw: Dinner 17:00–21:30 (food L.O. 20:00, drinks 20:30), Tuesday–Saturday; Sunday 17:00–21:00; closed Monday; lunch on Saturdays and Sundays by reservation made the day before (Tabelog). Reservation only; parties of six or more by enquiry; cancellation policy applies (Tabelog). Strollers and wheelchairs are not allowed; the dining room is upstairs (Tabelog; August 2025). Cards and e-money (Tabelog). 26 seats at tables with screens; private rooms; no smoking inside or in front (Tabelog; official site). Shoes off at the entrance (November 2025). Three doors from Hankyu Omiya Stn exit 1, 2 min from Randen Shijo-Omiya Stn (Tabelog). A yuba restaurant since the Taisho era (March 2026 review).
kyoto_yuba_kameya_honke.notes: [Yuba · Shijo-Omiya, a Taisho-era yuba house with a vegan course] An old townhouse yuba restaurant by Hankyu Omiya Station: fresh yuba sashimi, dengaku, the soy-milk yuba hot pot, and a fully plant-based shojin kaiseki (no fish dashi, egg, dairy or alliums) for ¥5,000 plus tax. Reservation only; dining room upstairs, shoes off; no strollers or wheelchairs. Weekend lunch by advance booking.

chef_bio.background: A March 2026 reviewer calls it a long-established yuba restaurant dating from the Taisho era. Photos of Showa-era stars line the walls (November 2025). Reviewers describe friendly women staff (November 2025).
chef_bio.specialty: Yuba hot pot; fresh yuba sashimi; shojin kaiseki.

anecdotes.text: A November 2025 diner on the vegan “Rokujo” course was told the crispy fried yuba was made from the edges scooped up while making yuba.
A November 2025 guest was quizzed by the staff on how to read “hiryozu”.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 湯葉料理 かめや本家、中京区大宮通四条上ル錦大宮町135、町家で湯葉料理、ゆば鍋、湯豆腐、生麩の懐石、全席椅子・テーブル席、阪急大宮駅から3軒目、精進懐石 (六条) 5,000円 (税別): 先附け、前菜、湯豆腐、胡麻豆腐、生湯葉刺身、田楽、小鉢、煮物、精進揚げ、蒸し物、ご飯、汁物、漬物、デザート、「魚、海老、蟹、肉、貝、卵、乳製品、ネギ、ニンニク、ニラ、ラッキョウ、タマネギ、魚の出汁等は使用しておりません」。食べログ: 豆腐料理、火〜土 17:00〜21:30、日 17:00〜21:00、月曜定休、土日の昼は前日までに予約、完全予約制、ベビーカー・車椅子不可、26席、禁煙 (店の前も)。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 大正からの老舗、生湯葉の刺身、田楽、湯葉と海老の春巻き、湯葉鍋、焼き生麩、2階の席、靴を脱ぐ。

cultural_comfort.note: Reservation only; upstairs, shoes off; no strollers or wheelchairs.

vegan_cross_contact.text: The plant-based Rokujo course is cooked in the same kitchen as yuba courses that include shrimp spring rolls; whether pans or fryers are separated is not stated.

positives.text: Official shojin kaiseki “Rokujo” uses no fish, shellfish, meat, egg, dairy, alliums or fish dashi (official menu).

existence.note: Official site and Tabelog; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_me_me_me_coffee.gf_detail: Not gluten-free as a menu: pancakes (including cornmeal pancakes, flour not stated), French toast, toast (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_me_me_me_coffee.vegan_detail: Not vegan: breakfast plates with bacon, eggs and dairy (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_me_me_me_coffee.hours_raw: 8:30–15:00 daily; irregular closures (Tabelog; hours may change). No reservations; order and pay at the register first (Tabelog; February 2026). Fills by mid-morning, waits of 15–20 minutes around 10:00 (November 2025; March 2026). Cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners) and e-money; no QR (Tabelog). 16 seats with a counter; non-smoking (Tabelog). Original merchandise (August 2026). Down an alley near the Kamo River, 5 min from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog; December 2025).
kyoto_me_me_me_coffee.notes: [Breakfast café · near the Kamo River at Marutamachi] A small retro, American-feeling café in an alley off the Kamo, open from 8:30 for pancake plates — cornmeal pancakes with bacon and eggs, French toast — and good coffee or chai. Order at the register; queues by 10:00. Some reviewers found the service brusque.

chef_bio.background: No owner is named in the sources read. Two 2026 reviewers found the service cold, one describing food and napkins being tossed onto the table (April 2026).

anecdotes.text: A December 2025 guest staying near Kyoto University walked along the Kamo River to breakfast and tried cornmeal pancakes for the first time.
A November 2025 visitor got in at 8:30 on a Sunday and watched it fill up right after.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ミーミーミー (ME ME ME)、カフェ・パン、上京区上生州町210、神宮丸太町駅から徒歩5分、毎日8:30〜15:00、不定休、予約不可、カード (JCB、AMEX、Diners)・電子マネー可、16席、禁煙。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 「ミーミーミー」と読む、アメリカ風の朝食カフェ、パンケーキのセット (ベーコン、目玉焼き、サラダ、果物、ドリンク) 1,800円、コーンミールのパンケーキ、フレンチトースト、トーストとコーヒーの朝食約1,400円、チャイラテ、先に会計、10時頃は待つ、接客が冷たいとの声も。

cultural_comfort.note: Order and pay at the register; busy mornings.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_shoku_to_mori.gf_detail: Ask. A single plate lunch that changes — sawara and vegetable tempura, tofu hamburg steak — plus pudding; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
kyoto_shoku_to_mori.vegan_detail: Ask. Seasonal Kyoto-vegetable plate lunches, sometimes with a tofu hamburg, but most days include fish, and dashi and seasonings are not described (Tabelog shop text; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_shoku_to_mori.hours_raw: 11:30–15:00 (L.O. 14:30) daily, closing early when food runs out; irregular closures (Tabelog). Reservations accepted, including same-day; walk-ins wait for the second sitting (Tabelog; March and May 2026). One lunch menu, different on weekdays and holidays (September 2026). Cash only (Tabelog; September 2026). 20 seats on tatami and at low tables over two floors; shoes off; kotatsu-style chairs on request (Tabelog; May–June 2026). Children welcome (Tabelog). Down narrow alleys between Higashi Hongan-ji and Nishi Hongan-ji, about 13 min from Gojo Stn, 15 min from Kyoto Station (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Opened 8 June 2022 (Tabelog).
kyoto_shoku_to_mori.notes: [Plate lunch · between the Hongan-ji temples, a one-person machiya café] A 100-year-old townhouse café down narrow alleys, with tatami and low tables over two floors, where a single cook turns out one carefully made plate lunch a day — crisp sawara and vegetable tempura, a tofu hamburg — and a firm Showa-style pudding. Book (even same-day) to avoid waiting; slow but worth it. Cash only.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s shop text describes dishes by an experienced chef in a converted Taisho-era townhouse. An April 2026 reviewer found the café “being managed by just one person”, cooking at the entrance kitchen; a February 2026 guest marvelled at one staff member covering both floors. A March 2026 reviewer wondered whether a couple runs it. A May 2026 guest found the building’s age and a restroom without a hand basin unsettling, though the food was outstanding.

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 guest with leg trouble was seated on a kotatsu chair with a view of the courtyard.
An October 2026 holiday visitor waited about 30 minutes; the reviewer advises coming with time to spare.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 食と森、カフェ、下京区蛭子水町605、五条駅から徒歩13分、毎日11:30〜15:00 (L.O.14:30)、売り切れ次第終了、不定休、予約可、現金のみ、20席、座敷、子ども可、2022年6月8日オープン。店の紹介: 大正時代の町家を改装したカフェ、経験のある料理人の料理、京野菜の季節のプレートランチ。口コミ (2026年、英語): ランチは平日と休日でひとつずつ、鰆と野菜の天ぷら、豆腐ハンバーグのプレート、固めのプリン、ひとりで切り盛り、靴を脱いで座敷、待つこともある。

cultural_comfort.note: One set lunch; shoes off on tatami; cash only; reservations advised.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_murin_an_cafe.gf_detail: Ask. A tea-and-sweets set — matcha, dorayaki, monaka ice, dry sweets, Russian cakes from Murakami Kaishindo — none described for gluten (2026 reviews).
kyoto_murin_an_cafe.vegan_detail: Ask. Matcha and juices are plant-based; the sweets are not described (2026 reviews).
kyoto_murin_an_cafe.hours_raw: April–September 9:00–18:00, October–March 9:00–17:00; last entry 30 minutes before closing; reservations given priority (Tabelog). Garden admission ¥600 plus a café set ¥1,200 — any drink with any sweet; items are not sold singly (July–September 2026); entry and café can be booked together online (August 2026). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 20 seats, mostly tatami, facing the garden (Tabelog). Inside the garden villa of Yamagata Aritomo by Nanzen-ji, 7 min from Keage Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_murin_an_cafe.notes: [Garden café · Nanzen-ji, Yamagata Aritomo’s villa] Tea on the tatami of a Meiji-era villa looking over one of Kyoto’s great modern gardens, laid out by the seventh-generation Ogawa Jihei for Yamagata Aritomo. Pay the ¥600 garden entry, then a ¥1,200 set of matcha or juice with a sweet (dorayaki, monaka ice, Murakami Kaishindo Russian cake). Book ahead; open from 9:00.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s shop text: the villa was built for the politician Yamagata Aritomo between 1894 and 1896, and the garden was made by the seventh-generation Ogawa Jihei on Yamagata’s instructions. Reviewers note an explanation of the garden before tea (August and October 2026) and its role in pre–Russo-Japanese War diplomatic talks (August 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Matcha and sweets with the garden view.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 visitor booked a combined entry-and-café ticket online for a 17:00 slot.
A September 2026 visitor finally tried the Russian cakes of Murakami Kaishindo here, never having managed to visit the shop.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 無鄰菴、カフェ、左京区南禅寺草川町31、蹴上駅から徒歩約7分、4〜9月 9:00〜18:00、10〜3月 9:00〜17:00、最終入場は閉場30分前、予約優先、カード・電子マネー・QR可、20席。店の紹介: 明治27〜29年にYamagata Aritomo が造営した別荘、七代目 Ogawa Jihei が作庭した近代日本庭園の名作を眺めながら抹茶を。口コミ (2026年、英語・日本語): 入場料600円とカフェのセット1,200円 (飲み物と菓子を自由に組み合わせ、単品不可)、抹茶とどら焼き、最中アイス、白桃ジュース、干菓子、村上開新堂のロシアケーキ、京都ビアルームの室町セゾン、事前予約がよい。

cultural_comfort.note: Garden admission ¥600 plus a ¥1,200 café set; many overseas visitors (September 2026); book ahead.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.
